title: Build a Household Budget That Actually Works
subtitle: A practical household money guide
reader_problem: A household is unsure where its monthly income goes and needs a realistic plan for bills, essentials and irregular expenses.
reader_profile: South African households seeking a practical first or reset budget.
promise: Help readers map dependable income, track spending, plan known costs, build a workable monthly budget and review it over 30 days.
scope: General household budgeting education for a South African reader, using illustrative rand examples. No individual financial plan or debt counselling.
exclusions: Guarantees of savings or financial outcomes
